orchestration.objective: Bound every production graph node with executable state and decision contracts.
orchestration.boundary: LangGraph remains the sole graph runtime; domain policy is injected.

tool_use.objective: Route external tools through bounded reliability and budget contracts.
tool_use.boundary: Provider implementations stay behind ToolSpec and LLMClient boundaries.

tool_calling.objective: Separate model tool intent from harness authorization and execution.
tool_calling.boundary: The model may propose calls but cannot execute unregistered, paid, or side-effecting tools without authorization.

planning_replanning.objective: Make plans, refinements, and loop exits bounded and auditable.
planning_replanning.boundary: The harness owns lifecycle and bounds; the finance DomainPack owns finance planning policy.

rag.objective: Provide provenance-safe ingestion and bounded lexical, dense, and rerank retrieval.
rag.boundary: Finance disclosure policy is injected; H2 does not claim reader-visible quality benefit.

mcp.objective: Discover and execute external stdio MCP tools through existing harness contracts.
mcp.boundary: No HTTP transport, marketplace, OAuth, or multi-tenant credential platform.

skills.objective: Load selected skill metadata, resources, and capabilities without bypassing harness controls.
skills.boundary: Finance remains the only product skill/domain; additional packs are test fixtures only.

memory.objective: Give working, episodic, semantic, and procedural memory truthful scope and lifecycle contracts.
memory.boundary: Memory preserves provenance and as-of semantics and does not create a second business truth source.

reflection.objective: Separate deterministic signals, strategy proposals, validation, and adoption decisions.
reflection.boundary: Reflection cannot mutate state directly and H2 does not claim LLM judgment quality.

content_security.objective: Apply trust and injection handling consistently to web, RAG, MCP, and skill content.
content_security.boundary: Security controls may reject untrusted instructions but may not weaken the golden truth contract.

observability_replay.objective: Make capability activity, termination, cost, and replay evidence independently auditable.
observability_replay.boundary: Only completed trajectories claim strict replay; other terminal states claim offline validation.

storage_backends.objective: Keep storage protocols, schemas, and service-backed execution in parity.
storage_backends.boundary: SQLite and Postgres share contracts; Qdrant remains the configured vector service.
